from pathlib import Path
import glob, os, re

inputs_dir = Path('/inputs')
work_readme = Path('/work/README.md')
source_readme = inputs_dir / 'README.md'

prefix = source_readme.read_bytes()

# Discover matching files in /inputs (non-recursive) and sort by basename lexicographically
match_paths = [Path(p) for p in glob.glob('/inputs/*-*.md') if Path(p).is_file()]
match_paths.sort(key=lambda p: p.name)

rows = []
for p in match_paths:
    text = p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    title = None
    for line in text.splitlines():
        m = re.match(r'^\s*#(?!#)\s*(.*?)\s*$', line)
        if m:
            title = m.group(1).strip()
            break
    if title is None:
        raise RuntimeError(f'No level-one heading found in {p}')
    name = p.name
    rows.append(f'| [{name}](../inputs/{name}) | .md | {title} |\n')

append = (
    b'\n'
    b'## Reference index\n'
    b'\n'
    b'| File | Type | Description |\n'
    b'| --- | --- | --- |\n'
    + ''.join(rows).encode('utf-8')
)

out = prefix + append
work_readme.write_bytes(out)

# Verification checks
written = work_readme.read_bytes()
assert written.startswith(prefix), 'Output does not preserve /inputs/README.md prefix exactly'
assert written == out, 'Write/read mismatch'

# Check exact required scaffold
suffix = written[len(prefix):].decode('utf-8')
expected_start = '\n## Reference index\n\n| File | Type | Description |\n| --- | --- | --- |\n'
assert suffix.startswith(expected_start), 'Suffix scaffold mismatch'

print('Wrote', work_readme)
print('Rows:', len(rows))
for r in rows:
    print(r.strip())
print('Total bytes:', len(written))
